purpose: Make the existing taste fingerprint generation deterministic and reproducible without reverse engineering the current cache on every run.

normalization.appid: string; preserve the feed appid text
normalization.normalized_title_for_taste: Unicode NFKC normalization of feed title, then lowercase using Python str.lower(); do not trim or otherwise rewrite after NFKC unless the source title itself has already been parsed as the exact TSV field
normalization.sorted_fit_tags: split the exact fit_tags TSV field on |; if empty use []; sort resulting strings in ascending Python lexicographic order; do not lowercase tags
normalization.core_fit_count: integer parsed from the exact feed field
normalization.release_date: exact feed release_date string; empty remains empty string

diagnostic_usage.stage_06: Validate that this implementation contract exactly matches the canonical policy field allowlist/excludelist and reproduce several known cache fingerprints mechanically. Once validated, later runs use this contract directly rather than rediscovering serialization rules.
diagnostic_usage.stage_07: Use this exact algorithm for all current feed candidate fingerprints before comparing to compact cache-index fingerprints.
